game.name: Skate 3 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl)
game.desc: Skate 3 on Xbox 360 is a relatively realistic skateboarding simulation. Explore the city of Port Carverton and its three distinct neighbourhoods: downtown, campus and industrial. Different types of challenges await you, such as races and competitions. You can also create your own skatepark and share your creations with other players.
